summary: Iteration 125 — validated the new PRODUCTION-mode static prerender server end-to-end (40 pytest cases + 4 Playwright runs). All 14 requested features PASS except hero video playback. Confirmed: 319 pre-rendered pages served with rich raw HTML (product specs/FAQ/Product+FAQPage JSON-LD, 15 blog links, 24 case-study links), 94 products (test product 'hjdba' fully purged from API, DB, sitemap and build), unique per-page titles+descriptions on /, /products, /blog, /about, /contact, /solutions, HTTP 404 + branded 404 page for unknown routes, all 10 tested WordPress 301 redirects correct, /wp-content/* -> 301 /products, /llms.txt 200 text/plain starting '# Brightluxx', zero fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.cdnfonts.com requests with self-hosted Satoshi woff2 loading, cookie consent Accept/Decline working, /admin/login SPA shell + full admin login E2E to dashboard, Google Maps iframe on /contact, client-side routing works after prerendered page load, no mobile horizontal overflow. Auth playbook verified: bcrypt $2b$12$ hash, httpOnly+Secure+SameSite=none cookies, explicit-origin CORS with credentials at origin, 429 lockout on the 6th failed login, logout invalidates session. ONE HIGH-severity defect: the homepage hero video never plays.

critical.issue: Hero video NEVER plays on the homepage. Endpoint sets 'Accept-Ranges: bytes' but completely ignores the incoming Range header — a 'Range: bytes=0-1023' request returns HTTP 200 with the full 58.1 MB body instead of 206 Content-Range. Browser stays at readyState=0, buffered=0, paused=true even after 30s; only the poster image is ever visible. Also: the asset itself is 58.1 MB (far too large for a hero LCP element), the endpoint uses BLOCKING sync requests.get(stream=True) inside an 'async def' which stalls the FastAPI event loop for the whole 58 MB proxy transfer, and no ETag/Last-Modified/conditional-GET support.

minor.issue: Returns 405 Method Not Allowed (route registered for GET only). CDNs/browsers/link-checkers issue HEAD for media probing.

Fired on EVERY public page load (/, /products, /blog, /case-studies), returning 401 and logging a console error for every anonymous visitor. Should be gated to /admin/* routes or to the presence of the blx_access cookie.

Playbook requirement 5 NOT met: seeding only runs 'if not existing'. If ADMIN_SEED_PASSWORD is rotated in .env, the existing admin document is never updated, so the new password silently has no effect. Should upsert the hash when the env password differs.

Fallback path sets allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True — an invalid combination that browsers reject outright. Should fail fast instead of falling back to wildcard. (Currently masked because CORS_ORIGINS is set.)
Login brute-force lockout state is in-process memory only. It works today (single uvicorn worker) but resets on restart and is bypassable with >1 worker/replica.

ui_bugs.issue: Video element never reaches readyState>=2; remains paused with buffered=0 after 30s. Users only ever see the static poster image. Root cause is the /api/media Range bug + 58 MB file size (see backend critical).

On some cards the product title wraps to 2 lines and visually collides with the 'nits' metadata line underneath (observed on 'PoolView Retractable P2.9'). Reserve a fixed min-height / add line-clamp for the title.

issues: Cookie consent banner renders over the admin panel and overlaps the bottom of the 'Product Categories' list. Suppress CookieConsent on /admin/* routes.
The horizontal pill row is clipped mid-word at the right viewport edge with no visible scroll affordance (fade/arrow), so users cannot tell more filters exist.

action_items: CRITICAL: Implement HTTP Range support in serve_media (routes/homepage.py:38) — parse the Range header, forward it upstream, and return 206 with Content-Range/Content-Length. Or better: stop proxying large video through FastAPI and serve the hero MP4 from the CDN (files.ihgbrands.com) directly.
CRITICAL: Re-encode/shrink the hero video — 58.1 MB is unusable for a hero LCP element. Target <5 MB (H.264 720p + WebM/AV1 alternative), and consider preload='metadata'.
Replace the blocking sync requests.get in the async serve_media handler with httpx.AsyncClient streaming (currently blocks the event loop for the whole 58 MB transfer).
Stop calling /api/admin/me on public pages — gate it behind /admin/* or cookie presence to remove the 401 console noise for every visitor.
Make seed_admin idempotent-with-update: if ADMIN_SEED_PASSWORD differs from the stored hash, update it (playbook requirement 5).
Remove the allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True fallback in server.py; fail fast if CORS_ORIGINS/FRONTEND_URL is unset.
Fix ProductCard title/metadata collision and add a scroll affordance to the filter pill row.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/homepage.py:58-69 — advertising 'Accept-Ranges: bytes' while ignoring the Range header is worse than not advertising it: media players trust the header and then stall. This is the direct cause of the dead hero video.

routes/homepage.py:46 — sync `http_requests.get(..., stream=True)` inside `async def serve_media` blocks the event loop for the entire proxied transfer; a single hero-video request can starve all other API traffic.

prerender-server.js is 885 lines and holds two complete server implementations (DEV proxy + PRODUCTION static) plus 4 near-duplicate JSON-LD/meta injection helpers (injectMeta / injectMetaJsonLdOnly share ~40 identical lines). Split into prerender-server.dev.js, prerender-server.prod.js and a shared seo-inject.js.

prerender-server.js:29 — because build/ exists, the server is now permanently in PRODUCTION mode, so frontend hot-reload is dead in this preview container. Gate the mode on an explicit env var (e.g. SERVE_MODE) so devs can still get CRA/HMR without deleting build/.

STALENESS RISK: build/ is a point-in-time snapshot. Any CMS edit made through /admin now changes the API but NOT the 319 pre-rendered HTML files, so public pages will serve stale titles/descriptions/content until a rebuild. There is no rebuild/invalidation hook wired to admin writes — this needs an explicit strategy before deploy.

prerender-server.js production branch has no /api handling at all. It works in preview because k8s ingress splits /api, but it will break if the app is ever fronted by a single origin without that ingress rule.
prerender-server.js:436-480 — KNOWN_ROUTES/DYNAMIC_PATTERNS is now dead code in PRODUCTION mode (404 is decided by file existence). Delete it or share it, otherwise it will drift and mislead.

rca_of_the_issue: Hero video dead-on-arrival. Repro: GET https://brightluxx-catalog.preview.emergentagent.com/api/media/videos/hero-video-ede053db.mp4 with header 'Range: bytes=0-1023' -> HTTP 200 and the full 58,138,610-byte body (expected 206 + Content-Range). In-browser: load '/', wait 30s, evaluate document.querySelector('video') -> {readyState: 0, buffered: 0, paused: true, error: null}. Cause: routes/homepage.py serve_media() hard-codes 'Accept-Ranges: bytes' in the response headers and pipes the upstream object-storage body through a StreamingResponse, but never reads req.headers['Range'] nor forwards it upstream. Chrome's media stack sees Accept-Ranges, issues a ranged request for the moov atom, receives a non-206 full-file stream, and refuses to demux — so metadata is never parsed and readyState stays 0. Aggravating factors: the asset is 58 MB (no bitrate ladder, no WebM fallback) and the proxy uses a blocking sync requests call inside an async handler. Mitigation: forward the Range header to object storage and relay 206 + Content-Range/Content-Length, switch to httpx.AsyncClient, re-encode the hero to <5 MB, and ideally bypass the API entirely by serving the video from files.ihgbrands.com.
